item.title: Alumnus earns March of Dimes Prize
item.description: From ’Berg to Harvard: Muhlenberg alumnus Leonard Zon ’79 has been awarded the 2026 March of Dimes Prize in Developmental Biology.

item.title: Lauren Dennelly ’06 Writes Book on Parentification - Muhlenberg College
item.description: The psychology major with minors in English and women’s and gender studies was approached by a top publisher to write “Why You Never Got to Be a Kid: How to Heal When Your Parents Didn’t Parent.”

item.title: Six Alumni Work as Attorneys at Allentown Firm - Muhlenberg College
item.description: Fitzpatrick Lentz &amp; Bubba employs Mules from the classes of 1978, 1994, 2005, 2008, 2021, and 2022 in its office about two miles from campus.

item.title: Interfaith Organization Highlights Sabeen Safi ’26 - Muhlenberg College
item.description: Safi, a pre-dental public health major and student body president, helped build an interfaith space in Seegers Union.

item.title: Career Center Coaching Helps Olivia Reiss ’26 Land Theatre Job - Muhlenberg College
item.description: Reiss, an English and theatre double major, has a contract with Surflight Theatre in New Jersey after graduation.

item.title: Muhlenberg Names New VP for Enrollment Management - Muhlenberg College
item.description: Amy Becher previously served as vice president for enrollment management at Chatham University in Pittsburgh.

item.title: Student-Athlete Erin DiSandro ’26 Receives NCAA Scholarship - Muhlenberg College
item.description: The field hockey player, a pre-health biology major and public health minor, will be attending medical school at Temple University.

item.title: Accounting, Business, Economics, & Finance Dept. Hires Faculty - Muhlenberg College
item.description: Grace Simon will join the college as an assistant professor of business. Rupsha Dey will join as an assistant professor of finance.

item.title: Professional Organization Spotlights Career Center Program - Muhlenberg College
item.description: The National Association of Colleges and Employers highlighted the Sophomore Career Accelerator, a two-day program with visits to employers.

item.title: Photography Professor Assists Allentown AP Art Students - Muhlenberg College
item.description: Assistant Professor Antonio McAfee has been helping William Allen High School students photograph their artwork for their portfolios.

item.title: Baseball/Softball Dominate on New Home Fields
item.description: Mules baseball and softball teams enjoy dominating in season openers contests on their new home fields at Bicentennial Park and on-campus.

item.title: Four Faculty Receive Tenure and Promotion - Muhlenberg College
item.description: Earning tenure in 2026 are Katie Bucher (education), Michael Buozis (media and com), Gregory Collins (business), and Sarah Runcie (history).

item.title: Muhlenberg Earns 2026-2027 Military Friendly School Designation - Muhlenberg College
item.description: Muhlenberg College’s Division of Graduate and Continuing Education has earned recognition as a 2026-2027 Military Friendly School.

item.title: Muhlenberg College Announces 2026 Commencement Speaker and Honorary Degree Recipients - Muhlenberg College
item.description: Rajiv Vinnakota, president of the Institute for Citizens & Scholars, to address graduates at PPL Center on May 17
